learning_items: A zero-failure Verification generation must persist empty canonical failure, repair, and authority collections instead of relying on in-memory fallbacks.
Canonical zero-lineage initialization must be idempotent and must never overwrite existing failure, repair, transition, or attempt-fact history.
A not-required migration decision must still be represented by a generation-bound migration-status artifact before Operations proof reconstruction.

promoted_checks.statement: A successful zero-failure Verification run materializes every canonical lineage file and preserves pre-existing history byte-for-byte.
